'''Alee''' was a primarily<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Alee system/Legends|Alee system]], a part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was situated on the [[Ilosian Spur/Legends|Ilosian Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Tal Nami system/Legends|Tal Nami system]] as well as the [[Boz Pity system/Legends|Boz Pity system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

Alee was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Vippit]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which were already in the service of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species by [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]. The planet was also home to a substantial population of [[Ilosian]]s, natives of the nearby world [[Ilos]]<ref name="TEA" /> who were mostly employed as agricultural workers and [[Farmer/Legends|farmhands]].<ref name="LoNH" /> Alee had extensive [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] dealings with Mid Rim [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the Alee system was [[Attack on the Alee system|attacked]] by the military forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the [[Star/Legends|star]] system was held under the control of those invaders until at least [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alee was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-9.<ref name="TEA" />
